test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: L and A are classmates as well as good friends. In a class of 30 students, L has 10 unique friends and 5 friends who are common to A. A has a total of 17 friends in the class. How many students are friends with neither L nor A?
solution:
The given information can be represented by a Venn diagram as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/140f63b75a06cde5af75258a68a23ab90910c6e6b3088d48e0a57b5828782403.png] 

 
• Total students in class = 30
 
• Total friends of L and A = 10 + 5 + 12 = 27
 
• Number of students who are friends with neither L nor A = 30 - 27 = 3

Hence, **'option 2'** is the correct answer.
